title: Butuan experiences scorching 42-45°C heat index for second straight day

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A scorching heat index of 42 to 45 degrees Celsius was recorded in Butuan City since Tuesday, Nov. 3, triggering health advisories from local officials and widespread calls online for in-person class suspensions. Data released by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) Regional Services Division indicated that the temperature surged immediately following the rains brought by a low-pressure area during the Undas holidays.
